questions.stem: Why is respiration not the same as breathing?

options.text: Breathing only happens in animals, respiration only in plants
Breathing moves air in and out of the lungs, while respiration is a chemical reaction in cells
Breathing produces energy, respiration does not

questions.explanation: Breathing (ventilation) is the physical movement of air into and out of the lungs. Respiration is the chemical process that releases energy from glucose in every living cell.
